name: Teaching and Learning
description: Subject area covering the design, delivery and assessment of learning.

name: Curriculum
description: The **Curriculum** topic contains data related to the learning opportunities offered by an institution: courses, units, offerings and their outlines.

name: Student
description: Subject area covering people studying at the institution.

name: Enrolment
description: The Enrolment topic covers admission and enrolment of students into courses and units.

name: Course Catalogue
description: The published list of courses and units, their structure, credit points and prerequisites.

name: Unit Outlines
description: Approved unit outlines with learning outcomes and assessment schedules.

name: Student Enrolment Records
description: Records of which students are enrolled in which units and courses.

name: SRS_Course
description: Course master table in the student administration system.

name: SRS_Unit
description: Unit (subject) master table.

name: SRS_Course_Offering
description: A course offered in a teaching period at a campus.

name: SRS_Enrolment
description: A student's enrolment in a unit offering.

name: CMS_Unit_Outline
description: Unit outline document records in the curriculum management system.

name: LMS_Unit_Site
description: A unit's site in the learning management system.

name: EDW_Dim_Course
description: Conformed course dimension in the warehouse.

name: Student Records System (SRS)
description: Student records system for admissions and enrolments and results.

name: Curriculum Management System
description: Where courses and units are designed and approved before publication.

name: Learning Management System
description: Online learning platform hosting unit sites.

name: Enterprise Data Warehouse
description: The analytics platform's warehouse layer.

name: Relational Database Platform
description: Relational database platform hosting SRS and CMS schemas.

name: Lakehouse Platform
description: Lakehouse platform hosting the warehouse and analytics workloads.

name: Integration Platform
description: Integration platform.

name: CMS to SRS curriculum sync
description: Publishes approved courses and units from the CMS into SRS.

name: SRS to EDW ingestion
description: Nightly ingestion of SRS curriculum and enrolment tables into the warehouse.

name: Curriculum to Student Administration interface
description: The conceptual interface through which approved curriculum reaches student administration.

name: Academic Division
description: Faculties and the office of the Deputy Vice-Chancellor Academic.

name: Student Registry
description: Admissions and enrolment services.

name: Data and Analytics
description: The data platform and information governance unit.

name: Manager, Curriculum Systems
description: Owns the curriculum management system and its data.

name: Registrar
description: Accountable for student records.

name: Manager, Data Governance
description: Stewards information assets across the institution.

name: Information Architect
description: Maintains the business information model and the EA information domain.

name: Course
definition: A structured program of study leading to an award, composed of units.

name: Unit
definition: A discrete component of study within a course, with its own outline and assessment.

name: Enrolled Student
definition: A student with at least one current unit enrolment in a teaching period.

name: Unit outline completeness rate
description: Share of offered units with an approved outline before census date.
definition: Approved outlines divided by offered units

name: Enrolment record validity rate
description: Share of enrolment records passing validation rules.
definition: Valid records divided by all records

name: Curriculum Health Dashboard
description: Dashboard tracking outline completeness and offering readiness per faculty.

name: Enrolment Extract
description: Weekly extract of enrolments for government reporting.

name: Curriculum Development
description: Designing and approving courses and units.

name: Student Enrolment Management
description: Admitting and enrolling students.

name: Curriculum Management System Upgrade
description: Project replacing the curriculum management system.
